mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status != 'DONE' )::INTEGER AS overdue_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' AND status != 'DONE' )::INTEGER AS due_this_week_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE')::INTEGER AS done_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS')::INTEGER AS in_progress_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE')) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) END AS progress_rate FROM todos WHERE deleted_flg = FALSE
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS count FROM todos WHERE deleted_flg = FALSE GROUP BY status ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'TODO' THEN 1 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN 'DONE' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END
SELECT CAST(priority AS VARCHAR) AS label, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS count FROM todos WHERE deleted_flg = FALSE GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority
SELECT classification AS label, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS count FROM todos WHERE deleted_flg = FALSE GROUP BY classification ORDER BY classification

SELECT COALESCE(m.username, '未担当') AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)::INTEGER AS count FROM todos t LEFT JOIN todo_assignments ta ON t.id = ta.todo_id AND ta.deleted_flg = FALSE LEFT JOIN members m ON ta.member_id = m.id AND m.deleted_flg = FALSE WHERE t.deleted_flg = FALSE GROUP BY COALESCE(m.username, '未担当') ORDER BY count DESC, label ASC
